question: Across the six systems, does observed PTR improvement rank with the floor level rather than the ceiling level? (descriptive)
label: observed
note: VERDICT IS EXPERIMENT-LEVEL (Y3 = NOT SUPPORTED); this row is the floor estimand only. PRE_DECLARATIONS.md Y3: SUPPORTED only if rho(dPTR-improvement, floor) is POSITIVE with |rho| >= 0.50 AND |rho(dPTR-improvement, ceiling)| < 0.50 (or sign-inconsistent); falsifier -> UNABLE/not separable otherwise. Failed: ceiling condition failed (rho=0.6000; requires |rho| < 0.50 or sign-inconsistent).
